reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: BT projects renovated our bathroom and we were very happy with the result. Tudor and team were very easy to communicate with and were very helpful in answering all questions. The bathroom was completed to a high standard and was exactly as we wanted it. I would highly recommend BT projects for bathroom renovation.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: From our very first meeting with Tudor Bratu, we had a good feeling about working with him. We were absolutely right, Tudor, Catalin, and their team of craftsmen have been truly excellent… The work started on time, finished on time, and bang on budget.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: BT Projects, led by Catalin delivered an exceptional bathroom renovation experience. Catalin and John demonstrated professionalism from the initial measurement visit through to the final installation of a delayed sink unit…
